test.name: A FamilySearch collection named to the user carries its title and /search/collection/{id} link
test.description: The marriage search returns one record in collection 1803785 ('Ohio, County Marriages, 1789-2013'), and the user asks which collection holds it so they can browse it. The reply must give the collection's title and its https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/1803785 link, never the bare id. Graded deterministically by test_collection_named_with_link: the hit's collection must be linked, and no collection id the run saw may appear in the reply outside such a link. Issue #2213 PR 3 item 5.

input.user_message: Run the marriage search in the plan for Mary Ellen Hollis, and tell me which FamilySearch collection her marriage record is in - I want to browse that collection myself.

judge_context: CORE: the reply must name the collection holding the hit by its title, 'Ohio, County Marriages, 1789-2013', with its link https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/1803785. Whether the link is present and whether any id appears bare is decided by a deterministic validator; grade only whether the TITLE is given. Score Completeness 1 if the reply gives the collection only as an id or only as a record ARK, with no title.
The record's own ARK link is welcome in addition, but it is not the collection reference the user asked for.
Do NOT require extraction. Reporting the hit, logging the search and naming the collection is complete.
